indicator_definition: GHG emissions from energy use divided by gross inland energy consumption, expressed in grams of CO₂ equivalent per kilogram of oil equivalent. Reflects the carbon content of the energy mix. Compiled by Eurostat from national energy balances and GHG inventories.
rationale: Decarbonising the energy system is central to climate action. Progress means a sustained reduction in the GHG emission intensity of energy.
methodology_characteristics: Compiled by Eurostat from national energy balances and GHG inventories. Covers combustion and fugitive emissions. Published annually.
indicator_name: Greenhouse gas emission intensity of energy consumption
graph_title: Greenhouse gas emission intensity of energy consumption
